header: Staff training at your site or ours
bodytext:
Companies book half of all courses at Bildungsforum Marnau. Typical examples: a bookkeeping refresher for two people in accounts, German for a kitchen team, or the annual first-aid hours for the shop floor.

Company courses run at your address or in one of our four houses, in the morning if that suits your shifts better. You get one invoice and one contact, and the attendance list arrives the day the course ends.
